reason: I'd probably start the free trial like I do with every growth tool, but 3 days is nowhere near enough to see replies or bookings from cold DMs, so I'd cancel on day 3 and pay nothing. I won't put $147 a month behind something with zero published results.
objection: AI DMs sound robotic and prospects can tell. 'Reads the profile' usually means a templated line about their bio, and there are no results from any customer to show it's different.
would_change_my_mind: Real reply and booked-call numbers from a few customers in my niche, plus seeing sample DMs written for my own prospects during the trial that I'd actually send.
